about_the_game:
Welcome to Kleks Academy – a magical platforming adventure where your creativity shapes the world around you! Solve puzzles by drawing your own solutions. Build bridges, sketch staircases, or invent entirely new ways to overcome obstacles. In this game, your imagination isn’t just encouraged – it’s required.

Unleash your inner inventor and dive into a fairytale world packed with secrets, surprises, and whimsical charm.

USE YOUR IMAGINATION

Use your artistic touch to create real objects in the game world. Discover sketches, master combinations, and carve your own path through each level. Every challenge has more than one solution – yours is up to you.

EXPLORE A WORLD OF MYSTERIES

From enchanted forest to hidden corners of the Academy, every part of the environment may hold a secret. Experiment freely with no pressure – discovery is part of the fun. Grow your character and unlock new ways to interact with the magical world around you.

FAIRYTALE-INSPIRED STYLE

Meet quirky characters, embark on mystical quests, and design your own hero to experience a one-of-a-kind adventure. Explore magical stories inspired by Arabian Tales and many other timeless tales.
